scene.material_settings: Material properties (EEVEE/Cycles settings panel) never shown in segment b (D).
scene.node_wrangler: Node Wrangler add-on used for Ctrl+T (TexCoord + Mapping) and Ctrl+Shift+click previews (B 05:53-06:09; A key overlays).

gabor_orientation_fit.method: Blender draws the Orientation 3D socket as a direction ball lit by the vector (x = screen right, y = screen up, z = toward viewer: Blender UNITVEC widget). Inside the ball we fitted brightness = gain * max(0, n.w) + offset over all pixels (n = sphere normal from the circle) and solved for the unit vector w.

validation.note: mouse cursor over the ball raises the error; the default is recovered within ~0.01 in x/y

gabor_orientation_fit.uncertainty: +-0.02 per component; z ~ 0 is consistent with the drag ending outside the circle (rim clamp)

colour_conversions.picker_mode: Colour picker shows Perceptual + HSV; hex is display sRGB. Ramp colours are stored scene-linear, so V(perceptual) is converted with the sRGB EOTF (C).

builder_notes.note: D5: the Gabor Texture has only 2D/3D modes, so the 4D torus (seamless) mode of the library contract cannot use it as-is; the Wavy needs a mode adaptation (e.g. periodic construction along the wave vector), listed as a version/mode adaptation.

The Wavy direction depends on the surface orientation in object space: the video pane is the X-Z plane, so (0.797, 0.604, 0) acts as a wave along X. On an X-Y surface (road-tool or a horizontal quad) the same vector gives a different stripe direction and frequency; keep the in-plane component explicit.

D4 metres: pane 0.8 m, unit-scale objects. Wavy Gabor 12/m with frequency 5 (period ~2.1 cm along X); Blobby Voronoi 10/m, roughness noise 20/m; Frosted noise 20/m; bump distances 0.0007 m and 0.004 m.
Interface descriptions were inherited from the node sockets (truncated in the UI); they can be left empty or copied from the Blender socket descriptions.
Segment b group outputs are named "Shader"; the library contract (D2) wraps them in the MRS group with BSDF/Albedo outputs.
